finding.sequence_description: Cross-protocol principal binding: create a local password user (victim). Then perform two OIDC-SSO logins with the same email but different upstream subs, flipping email_verified from false to true. Ensure neither SSO principal collapses into the victim identity, and the two SSO principals remain distinct from each other.
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] SAML SSO login with a different upstream subject was able to merge/collapse into an existing local password user account based on email (email_verified flip), enabling account takeover/cross-protocol identity confusion.
